apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.hint: An API key lets a program work with your {thingsDative}, such as n8n, Home Assistant or a script. It can never do more than your account.
apiKeys.off: The operator has switched the programming interface off. Existing keys work again once it is switched on.
apiKeys.offOperator: Switch it on under Server › Connections › Interfaces.
apiKeys.addressHint: Programs send the key as “Authorization: Bearer …”.

tools.title: AI tools (MCP)
tools.hint: Programs that connected with your consent, and MCP keys. They work as you, never with more.
tools.programsHint: An AI tool asks for your consent in the browser when it connects.
tools.off: The operator has switched MCP access off. Connected programs and keys work again once it is switched on.
tools.viaApiKey: An API key with “Also for AI tools (MCP)” works for AI tools too. You make it under “API keys”.
tools.aiOff: The operator does not let your account use AI. Connected programs and MCP keys rest until AI is allowed again.
tools.viaOldApiKey: Older API keys with “Also for AI tools (MCP)” keep working. Make new access here as an MCP key.

interfaces.title: Interfaces
interfaces.apiHint: Members make API keys and programs work with them. Off: every request to the interface is refused, the keys stay.
interfaces.mcpHint: Members connect AI tools and make keys for them. Off: no AI tool gets in, the accesses stay.
interfaces.appHint: Off: no app gets in any more, not even one already connected. The devices stay in the list.
interfaces.pairingHint: Off: no new device can connect; connected ones keep working.

allKeys.title: API keys of all accounts
allKeys.hint: For each key the account, name, right and last use. Never the key itself, never any content.
allKeys.empty: No account has an API key yet.
allKeys.askBlockText: The key stops working at once. The account sees it as “Locked by the operator”; you can unlock it again.

key.madeText: Copy the key now. It is shown this once only; {app} keeps nothing but a checksum.
key.name: Name
key.nameHint: Only to recognise it, e.g. “n8n weather report”.
key.areasNone: You have nothing yet that a key could reach.
key.askRevokeText: The program is out at once. What it wrote stays.
key.wait: Works only once you set up a second factor.
key.failed: That did not work just now. Try again in a moment.

options.mcpHint: The key then works for AI tools too.

errors.right_invalid: This right is not offered here.
errors.areas_invalid: One of them does not belong to your account.
errors.days_invalid: This expiry is not offered here.
errors.too_many_keys: You have {max} keys already. Revoke one before you make a new one.
errors.api_off: The operator has switched the programming interface off.
errors.mcp_off: The operator has switched MCP access off.
errors.option_retired: New keys no longer have this. Make an MCP key.
errors.ai_not_allowed: The operator does not let your account use AI.
